summary: Full e2e testing of D-ID -> Agora Conversational AI replacement. Backend: 9/10 tests passed (1 failure due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhaustion, not a code bug — first chat call succeeded). Frontend: 12/12 checks passed — mode toggle correctly placed on the right of the chatbox inside the form, no <video> elements anywhere, Agora voice panel renders with proper error fallback when microphone unavailable in headless, hangup returns to chat mode. /api/chat-with-avatar correctly returns 404.

minor.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY hits 'Budget has been exceeded! Max budget: 0.001' after ~2-3 calls. Backend correctly surfaces this as 502. Test environment / key issue, not application bug — but production users will hit this quickly. Recommend increasing budget on the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.

backend.POST /api/chat-text success: PASS - returns {text, session_id} with non-empty text
backend.POST /api/chat-text session continuity: FAIL (502, but root cause = LLM budget exhausted, NOT code bug)
backend.POST /api/agora/start: PASS - returns {app_id, channel, rtc_token (signed), uid:int, agent_id:str, agent_uid:int}; channel starts with 'aria-'

frontend.Text chat shows avatar-text + avatar-img: PASS (error fallback text shown due to LLM budget exhaustion, integration wiring correct)
frontend.voice-status (connecting/error/live) sho: PASS (shows voice-status-error as expected in headless — mic DEVICE_NOT_FOUND)

action_items: Increase EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget — current $0.001 cap is exhausted after ~2-3 chat-text calls. Backend correctly returns 502 on budget exhaustion and frontend correctly shows fallback message, so app behavior is graceful.

(Optional) Consider also calling /api/agora/stop in CarShowcase.js when the car is switched while in voice mode — currently mode resets to 'chat' on car change which unmounts VoicePanel and triggers its cleanup, so this is already handled correctly. No action required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/agora/stop returns HTTP 200 with {ok: false} when Agora's leave endpoint returns >=400. That's intentional (graceful fallback so frontend can clean up) but worth noting — an Agora-side failure is silently swallowed. Consider logging to monitoring.

VoicePanel.js getVolumeLevel() polling at 200ms with no try/finally interval cleanup if remoteAudio is replaced — minor leak risk if multiple remote users publish. Currently only one remote (the agent), so fine.

server.py uses int.from_bytes(uuid.uuid4().bytes[:3], 'big') + 1000 for uid (24-bit + 1000). agent_uid = user_uid + 1. Birthday-collision risk in a 24-bit space is low for short-lived channels, acceptable.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap of $0.001 is far too low for any real usage — needs to be raised by infra.

success_rate.backend: 9/10 = 90% (1 failure due to LLM budget exhaustion, NOT code bug — graceful error path works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Agora Conversational AI fully replaces D-ID. Backend: /api/chat-text (Emergent LLM gpt-4.1-mini), /api/agora/start (calls Agora .../join with preset 'openai_gpt_4_1_mini,minimax_speech_2_8_turbo'), /api/agora/stop (calls .../agents/{id}/leave). Old /api/chat-with-avatar removed. Frontend: CarShowcase has mode toggle inside chatbox form on the right; AvatarResponse is text-only (static Aria image, no <video>); VoicePanel uses agora-rtc-sdk-ng. In headless tests, microphone is unavailable so VoicePanel shows voice-status-error (DEVICE_NOT_FOUND) — this IS expected and is the correct behaviour to verify. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has a tiny budget ($0.001) so /api/chat-text returns 502 after a few calls — frontend shows fallback 'Sorry, I couldn't reach...' text, which is correct.
rca of the issue: The single failing backend test (test_chat_text_session_persists) failed with 502 because by the 3rd LiteLLM call the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget ($0.001 max) was exhausted (current cost $0.001086). server.py correctly wraps LLM errors and returns HTTP 502 with detail. Mitigation: raise the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget on the infra side; no code change required.
